Cockatrice (CV 13)

A ragged rooster's head rises from a lean reptilian body, its spurs dusted with the pale grit of old victims.

Attributes: Brawn +0; Fortitude +0; Agility +2; Guile +1; Knowledge +0; Reason +1

HP: 14 · Speed: 6; fly 4 · Size: 1 (medium) · Armor DR: 0

Evasion: 1 Bane · Threat: None · Stability: 0

Weaknesses: None\ Resistances: None\ Immunities: None

Actions

Damage and effects are Weak / Standard / Strong player defense. Each slash separates a complete outcome. All attacks use printed Threat unless stated otherwise.

Details

Calcifying peck

Target: One adjacent creature. Player defense: Fortitude. Damage type: physical.

Weak defense: Paralyzed 1.

Limit: Cannot use this attack on consecutive turns, regardless of result.

Wing Step

A single hard wingbeat carries it toward a better angle.

Move up to 2 squares using its printed fly speed without provoking from one visible enemy chosen before moving. Pay normal terrain costs and provoke normally from other enemies. This grants no attack, automatic lift of another creature or hovering exception.

General details

Basic Melee: One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses printed Threat. No specialty riders.

Defend: Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules; repeated Defend does not stack.

Opportunity Attack: Basic Melee against the provoking creature; spend its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if capable.

Healing: Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

Senses: Ordinary sight and hearing.

Tactics and retreat: Peck a close threat, then withdraw with a wingbeat during the pause before another numbing attack. Its brief paralysis is not permanent petrification.

Encounter and conversation: A farmer has penned it beside ordinary hens, insisting that the strange eggs are worth the trouble.

Habitat: Wild frontier; ancient ruin · Communication: None

Loot: Recoverable possessions or lair clues chosen for the adventure; body parts grant no automatic special equipment or coin value.

Summoning: Ineligible.

Design notes — not needed during play
